name: Adelaide
source: Adelaide is one of the 3 dolls that was created by a doll maker many years ago. Unlike Lottie and Briar, Adelaide was made for darkness. To be a weapon. She has killed many people. With each day, Adelaide's power increases. While she can only be active at night, Adelaide will do everything she can to kill Reuben.
